model_annotation: The chart compares the relative proportions of various categories in 2014 (inner circle) and 2021 (outer circle). The chart is divided into 16 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories include "Kultur" (dark grey, 2.2% in 2014), "Sport/Erholung" (light grey, 3.6% in 2021), "Wohnungswesen" (light blue, 7.3% in 2021), "Abwasserentsorgung" (blue, 7.8% in 2021), "Abfallwirtschaft" (dark blue, 3.4% in 2021), "Stromversorgung" (green, 8.9% in 2021), "Gasversorgung" (light green, 1.5% in 2021), "Wasserversorgung" (teal, 8.8% in 2021), "Kombinierte Versorgung" (purple, 6.5% in 2021), "Übrige Versorgung" (pink, 1.3% in 2014), "Wirtschaftsförderung" (beige, 4.7% in 2014), "Verkehr" (brown, 3.7% in 2014), "Kliniken" (light brown, 3.2% in 2014), and "Übrige" (grey, 38.1% in 2014 and 31.1% in 2021). The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown inside or next to each slice. The slices are arranged in a somewhat ordered manner, with larger categories generally placed towards the top and smaller ones towards the bottom, although this is not a strict ordering. The inner and outer circles are visually distinct, with the inner circle representing the 2014 data and the outer circle representing the 2021 data.
